digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and pytest test selection routing
propositions: Nineteen immutable repository-policy AST/text inspection nodes are redundantly executed in all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite having OS/Python-invariant contracts.

A strict repo_policy pytest marker must be registered and applied exactly to the 19 inventoried function-level nodes across seven mixed modules, leaving runtime/subprocess/filesystem behavior unmarked.

The shared workflow default selector must remain unchanged for Ubuntu 3.13 (primary cell) and append and not repo_policy only to Ubuntu 3.11, Ubuntu 3.12, and macOS 3.13 default selections with no new job or pytest session.

The workflow-parity test must pin the exact 19-node inventory, prove marked/unmarked partitioning, prove the four-cell matrix remains intact, prove exactly two pytest sessions remain, and prove integration routing is unchanged.
Marked repository-policy cases must pass on Ubuntu 3.13, be absent from the other three default selections, and all unmarked cases in mixed modules must retain their original selection.
